description: This file defines a test implementation of the TimeZoneMonitor interface for testing purposes in the Android project. It provides a way to set and observe the current TimeZone during tests.

classes.name: TestTimeZoneMonitor
classes.description: A test implementation of the TimeZoneMonitor interface that allows setting the current TimeZone during tests.

methods.name: setTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the current TimeZone to the specified zoneId. Used primarily for testing.
